answer: Publish a lantern of irreversible micro-burns to random sinks each epoch; payouts vest only after a multi-epoch horizon of unbroken burns. The crystal of sink addresses, amounts, and timing fingerprints shared wallets, so keys that fund from one pool collapse into one reward. A farm must seed and top up distinct wallets per key for the whole horizon; cloning a lantern pattern from one wallet fails the crystal check and burns the vested pile.
